type: freelance designer portfolio — transferable minimal pattern
moves: pure #000 background, white text, zero decoration
NO hero, NO tagline: page opens directly with project list
row = project name (18px regular) + 2 screenshots side by side; infinite scroll
header 2 items: name left / 'Profile, Email me' right
screenshots are the only color on the page
rules_derived: restraint as a statement: 1 font, 1 size, 1 weight for all text
the work must be good enough to carry the page — pattern only for portfolios with strong visuals
no CTA buttons at all; contact is a text link
